title: How to Compare Plant-Based Event Menus
body_html:
Compare a plant-based event menu as a complete meal. Look at ingredients, variety, portions and preparation, and discuss allergies separately from vegan preferences.

For the service options, explore catering services in Dubai. Use this guide to prepare the details for your enquiry.

About this guide

This guide is published by myCHEF, a provider of private chef and catering services. It compares service formats and practical selection criteria. Individual providers should be assessed through their current proposals, relevant documentation and suitability for your occasion.

Review the complete menu

Look for a clear progression of flavours and textures, with vegetables, grains, pulses and suitable plant-based ingredients contributing to the meal. Ask how the menu accommodates guests who are familiar with vegan food and those trying it for the first time.

Check components and preparation

Stocks, sauces, pastry, garnishes and sweets can contain animal-derived ingredients. Confirm that the agreed dishes exclude meat, fish, dairy, eggs, honey and gelatin. Discuss shared preparation areas and any ingredient substitutions before the event.

Separate dietary preference from allergy needs

A vegan dish can still contain nuts, soy, wheat or sesame. Give the provider a complete allergy brief and ask about feasible controls and remaining cross-contact risk. Pricing depends on the service format and ingredients, so compare delivery, buffet and plated options on their own terms.

Questions to ask before confirming

Request a written menu and scope, confirm the guest count and service hours, and check which staff, equipment and extras are included. Share dietary requirements before approving the menu. Review the payment schedule, change deadlines and cancellation terms, and identify the contact who will coordinate the booking.

Use your completed brief

If vegan catering suits your plans, explore the service details and published options below. Share your date, Dubai location, guest count and preferences so the team can assess availability and prepare a tailored proposal. The written booking confirms the final menu, responsibilities and price.
